items.title: 9.8.4 Weak acids aur weak bases ke salts (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.8.4, printed page 205.

blocks.text: Weak acids aur weak bases se bane salts, jaise ammonium acetate NH4CH3COO, ke liye conjugate acid (NH4+) aur conjugate base (CH3COO-) dono pH par asar karte hain. NH4CH3COO(aq) se NH4+(aq) + CH3COO-(aq); NH4+ hydrolyse ho kar H3O+ banata hai, NH4+ + H2O se NH3 + H3O+, aur CH3COO- hydrolyse ho kar OH- banata hai, CH3COO- + H2O se CH3COOH + OH-. Nateeje ka pH conjugate acid aur conjugate base ki nisbati taqat par munhasir hai: solution tezabi, basic ya taqreeban neutral ho sakta hai, is par munhasir ke kaun sa reaction ghalib hai.

blocks.prompt: Ammonium oxalate ka aabi solution tezabi hoga ya basic? Muadlon se wazahat karein (Quick Check 9.5c).
blocks.explanation: Ammonium oxalate, (NH4)2C2O4, weak base NH3 aur weak acid oxalic acid ka salt hai, to dono ions hydrolyse hote hain: NH4+ + H2O se NH3 + H3O+ aur C2O4 2- + H2O se HC2O4- + OH-. pH is par munhasir hai ke kaun sa zyada taqatwar hai; oxalic acid ammonia ke base hone se khasa zyada taqatwar acid hai, to us ka oxalate ion ammonium se kam hydrolyse hota hai aur solution halka sa tezabi hone ki tawaqqo hai.

items: Weak acid + weak base salt (NH4CH3COO): dono ions hydrolyse hote hain, NH4+ H3O+ aur CH3COO- OH- deta hai; pH conjugate acid aur base ki nisbati taqat par munhasir.
